content.text: Digital creators often face a challenging landscape when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-online-without-gumroad-what-actually-how-works-4|selling]] products online, particularly in regions where established platforms like PayPal and Stripe are either unavailable or heavily restricted. This leaves many creators in countries like Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela in a bind, as they seek to monetize their digital products while navigating complex payment processing hurdles. The infrastructure choices available can significantly impact their ability to succeed. This comparison outlines effective [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-design-assets-crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-11|COREMERCH guide to payments]]-11|The Real]]s for selling digital products with crypto, eliminating reliance on mainstream payment platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-11. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

Mainstream platforms like Gumroad or Payhip provide basic functionality for selling digital products. However, they come with hefty fees, such as Gumroad's 10% on every sale. Alternatively, COREMERCH’s Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack offer fully operational online stores with automatic crypto payment processing and complete data ownership. The Sovereign Starter Stack allows for up to three products and essential support, while the Edge Commerce Stack enhances functionality with five products, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and end-to-end testing. These offerings ensure that creators have a robust solution tailored to their specific needs, standing in stark contrast to the limitations imposed by mainstream platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

For creators situated in regions with restricted access to payment platforms, the options become limited when relying on traditional solutions. Platforms like Gumroad and PayPal may not even be accessible, leaving creators to seek alternatives. In contrast, COREMERCH is built specifically for these creators, providing an infrastructure that functions regardless of geographic restrictions. By using services like NOWPayments for crypto payments, creators can accept payments from a variety of cryptocurrencies without the burden of KYC requirements or account restrictions. This architecture empowers creators in restricted regions to monetize their work effectively and efficiently.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When evaluating fees and payment processing, the differences are stark. Gumroad takes a 10% cut from every sale, which can severely cut into profits. For instance, selling 100 units of a $97 product would result in a fee of $970, while using NOWPayments would only incur a 0.5% fee, totaling just $48.50. This means that the fee difference retains a profit of $921 for the creator. Additionally, NOWPayments facilitates faster crypto transactions, ensuring that payments are confirmed on-chain almost instantly, allowing for a more seamless experience compared to traditional payment processors, which can delay funds for several days.
Gumroad's 10% fee can decimate your profits; NOWPayments only takes 0.5%.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of data and content is critical for digital creators. Mainstream platforms often retain access to your data and control over your products, which can be risky. COREMERCH offers a fully sovereign solution where creators own their entire stack post-deployment. With automated delivery systems powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, creators can ensure that purchased products are delivered instantly and securely. This level of automation not only enhances the customer experience but also allows creators to focus on their craft rather than managing logistics. The architecture provided ensures full ownership and control over the entire sales process.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture hinges on your specific needs and circumstances. If you're just starting and need a simple solution, the Sovereign Starter Stack provides a solid foundation with essential features. For those looking to scale or handle more complex needs, the Edge Commerce Stack is ideal, offering greater flexibility and automation. If you want comprehensive resources to build and expand, consider the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all blueprints and templates needed for effective deployment. Ultimately, the choice should align with your goals, the types of products you sell, and your anticipated growth trajectory.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a crypto payment solution like NOWPayments integrated into a sovereign digital storefront. This approach allows you to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, avoiding the limitations of traditional platforms while maintaining full ownership of your products and customer data.
Sovereignty means you own everything — no platform can dictate your terms.

For those seeking an efficient way to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197). It encompasses all blueprints and templates you need to establish and scale your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify the digital products you want to sell and choose the appropriate COREMERCH stack that fits your needs. Set up your online store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages based on your chosen stack. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing to ensure seamless transactions. Configure automated delivery options using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for instant product fulfillment. Launch your store and promote your products through social media and other marketing channels.
